wolfram.note: Ours gives an empty Shape: Array(a, {2, 1, 4, 3}) evaluates to the nested list of a(i, j, k, l), and a nested list of applications of an unknown function has no shape here (a list of Sin(1), Sin(2) does). Wolfram's Dimensions gives {2, 1, 4, 3}.
Wolfram's Dimensions reads Sqrt[2], that is Power[2, 1/2], as an array of its two arguments ({2}); ours takes a scalar to have an empty shape.
